title: GameGo：基于真实资产合成轨迹训练游戏开发智能体
summary: GameGo 框架将简短游戏创意转化为基于行业实践的产品需求文档，通过动态压缩保留核心玩法约束，构建了含 55,060 条开发轨迹的 GameGoData 数据集和 124 个查询的 GameGoBench 基准，训练出的 GameGoCoder 模型性能超越同类基线，接近前沿模型水平。
summary_en: GameGo is a scalable framework that transforms brief game seeds into comprehensive Product Requirements Documents grounded in industry practices, using task-specific dynamic compression to preserve gameplay constraints. It builds GameGoData with 55,060 development trajectories across 2D/2.5D/3D games and GameGoBench with 124 game queries. The trained GameGoCoder outperforms matched baselines and rivals frontier models on gamedev benchmarks.
